title: Detecting Protein-DNA Binding in Single Molecules using Antibody Guided Methylation
authors: Apoorva Thatavarty; Naor Sagy; Michael R Erdos; Isac Lee; Jared T Simpson; Winston Timp; Francis S Collins; Daniel Z Bar
one_liner_zh: 该文开发基于抗体引导甲基化的单分子蛋白-DNA结合检测实验方法，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但无AI或物理模拟建模，方法创新有限，与课题核心的TF-DNA结合机制建模关联较弱。
abstract: Characterization of DNA binding sites for specific proteins is of fundamental importance in molecular biology. It is commonly addressed experimentally by chromatin immunoprecipitation and sequencing (ChIP-seq) of bulk samples (10 3 -10 7 cells). We have developed an alternative method that uses a Chromatin Antibody-mediated Methylating Protein (ChAMP) composed of a GpC methyltransferase fused to protein G. By tethering ChAMP to a primary antibody directed against the DNA-binding protein of interest, and selectively switching on its enzymatic activity in situ , we generated distinct and identifiable methylation patterns adjacent to the protein binding sites. This method is compatible with methods of single-cell methylation-detection and single molecule methylation identification. Indeed, as every binding event generates multiple nearby methylations, we were able to confidently detect protein binding in long single molecules. Abstract Figure Graphical abstract (i) ChAMP is added to fix and permeabilized cells, where it binds (ii) any antibody, and upon the addition of SAM, methylates nearby GpC sites, to be detected by sequencing (iii-iv).
abstract_zh: 特定蛋白质DNA结合位点的表征在分子生物学中具有根本重要性。这一问题通常通过批量样本（10³-10⁷个细胞）的染色质免疫沉淀和测序（ChIP-seq）实验来解决。我们开发了一种替代方法，利用由GpC甲基转移酶与蛋白G融合而成的染色质抗体介导甲基化蛋白（ChAMP）。通过将ChAMP锚定到针对目标DNA结合蛋白的一级抗体上，并在原位选择性激活其酶活性，我们在蛋白质结合位点附近生成了独特且可识别的甲基化模式。该方法与单细胞甲基化检测和单分子甲基化识别方法兼容。实际上，由于每个结合事件都会产生多个邻近的甲基化位点，我们能够在长单分子中可靠地检测蛋白质结合。摘要图 图形摘要 (i) 将ChAMP添加到固定和透化的细胞中，它结合 (ii) 任何抗体，并在添加SAM后，甲基化邻近的GpC位点，通过测序检测 (iii-iv)。
